allow: Bash(cmd.exe /c "flutter test test/unit/ --reporter compact > test_output.txt 2>&1 && type test_output.txt")

Bash(# Extract service names from lib/services
lib_services=$(find /mnt/c/Butlery/butlery/lib/services -type f -name ""*.dart"" | sed ''s|.*/||'' | sed ''s|\.dart$||'' | sort)

# Extract test names from test/unit/services  
test_services=$(find /mnt/c/Butlery/butlery/test/unit/services -type f -name ""*_test.dart"" | sed ''s|.*/||'' | sed ''s|_test\.dart$||'' | sort)

# Find services without tests
echo ""=== Services WITHOUT corresponding test files ===""
for service in $lib_services; do
    # Skip type files and templates
    if [[ ""$service"" == *""_types"" ]] || [[ ""$service"" == *""_templates"" ]]; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Check if test exists
    if ! echo ""$test_services"" | grep -q ""^${service}$""; then
        # Find the full path for context
        full_path=$(find /mnt/c/Butlery/butlery/lib/services -name ""${service}.dart"" | head -1)
        if [ -n ""$full_path"" ]; then
            echo ""$service | $(echo ""$full_path"" | sed ''s|/mnt/c/Butlery/butlery/lib/services/||'')""
        fi
    fi
done)

Bash(# Create temporary files
SERVICE_IMPL=""/tmp/service_impl.txt""
SERVICE_TEST=""/tmp/service_test.txt""

# Get service implementation file names (without path and extension)
find /mnt/c/Butlery/butlery/lib/services -type f -name ""*.dart"" | grep -v ""\.g\.dart"" | while read file; do
    basename ""$file"" .dart
done | sort > ""$SERVICE_IMPL""

# Get service test file names (without path and _test suffix)
find /mnt/c/Butlery/butlery/test/unit/services -type f -name ""*_test.dart"" | while read file; do
    basename ""$file"" _test.dart
done | sort > ""$SERVICE_TEST""

echo ""=== SERVICES WITHOUT TESTS ===""
comm -23 ""$SERVICE_IMPL"" ""$SERVICE_TEST"")
